skills.name: wake-checkout-flow

skills.name: wake-hotsite-banners
skills.description: Wake Commerce hotsite and landing pages. Use when building landing pages, promotional pages, or campaign URLs. Triggers on: hotsite, banners, contents, landing page, promotional page.
skills.description_zh: 构建Wake Commerce hotsite、落地页、促销页面及活动URL，处理banners和contents。

skills.name: wake-product-variants
skills.description: Wake Commerce variant resolution and add-to-cart. Use when building product detail pages, resolving variants via attributeSelections, or handling customizations and subscriptions. skills.description_zh: 构建Wake商品详情、按attributeSelections解析变体，并处理定制、subscriptionGroups及加入购物车。

headings: inline comment                  to end of line, inside a code block
skills.description_zh: 用于Wake Storefront SSR HTML内Scriban模板的编写、编辑、调试和解释，涵盖模板块及空白控制；源简介后部截断，未据此补写未显示内容。

skills.name: wake-storefront-api
skills.description: Wake Commerce Storefront API for headless storefronts. Use when building product pages, search, checkout, cart, or customer flows. Triggers on: Wake Storefront API, Wake Commerce GraphQL, product queries, checkout flow, cart, headless storefront.
skills.description_zh: 使用Wake Commerce Storefront GraphQL API构建无头商品、搜索、结账、购物车及客户流程。

skills.name: wake-storefront-reference-patterns
skills.description: Wake Storefront reference to headless mapping. Use when migrating from Wake Storefront templates, porting Queries/*.graphql, or aligning with production patterns. Triggers on: migrate, reference, Queries, productId vs handle, attributeSelections, addToCartFromSpot.
skills.description_zh: 将Wake Storefront模板及Queries GraphQL迁到无头实现，参照生产模式对齐productId/handle、attributeSelections及addToCartFromSpot等。

skills.name: wake-template
skills.description: Wake Commerce storefront template (sometimes called a "theme") anatomy — the required root folders (Assets, Blocks, Components, Configs, Emails, Pages, Queries, Root, Snippets) and the contracts behind `Configs/components.json`, `Configs/pages.json`, `Configs/settings.json`, `Configs/emails.json`, the Snippets/SnippetQueries pairing, and the Wake Design Studio CMS (Blocks + `content_for_page` on hotsite pages, paired `Blocks/<type>.html` + `Blocks/<type>.schema.json` files, and the `wake_has_content_for_page` / `wake_content_for_page` runtime helpers). Use when scaffolding a new Wake template, registering a Component, wiring a Page to a Query in `pages.json`, binding a Snippet to a SnippetQuery, adding an Email, exposing a new static asset, authoring a Design Studio Block (schema + HTML), configuring a hotsite `content_for_page`, deciding between a Block and a Component, or explaining how data flows from Queries → Pages/Snippets → Components → Blocks in a Wake storefront project. Triggers include "Wake template", "Wake theme" (synonym), "template folder structure", "components.json", "pages.json", "settings.json", "emails.json", "Configs/", "register component", "bind query to page", "scaffold a Wake template", "Wake storefront structure", "hotsite content_for_page", "Snippets + SnippetQueries pairing", "Wake Design Studio", "Wake CMS", "Design Studio block", "Wake block schema", "block_data", "wake_content_for_page", "wake_has_content_for_page", ".schema.json block", "merchant editable hotsite", "Storefront 2.0 CMS".
headings: 2. Data flow — Queries → Pages / Snippets → Components
skills.description_zh: 梳理Wake主题目录和Configs组件页面设置邮件契约，管理Snippets与查询配对、Design Studio的Block HTML/schema及hotsite content_for_page，支持脚手架注册及查询到页面组件Block的数据流。

skills.name: web-performance-audit
skills.description: Web performance and Lighthouse audits. Use when checking storefront performance, Core Web Vitals, accessibility, SEO, or best practices. Triggers on: performance audit, Lighthouse, PageSpeed, Core Web Vitals, LCP, CLS, INP, accessibility check.
skills.name_hint: 网页 · 性能/表现 · 审查
skills.description_zh: 开展店面Web性能及Lighthouse审计，检查Core Web Vitals、LCP、CLS、INP、PageSpeed、无障碍、SEO及最佳实践。

commands.name: wake-checkout-flow
commands.description: Implement full Wake Commerce checkout sequence. createCheckout → checkoutCustomerAssociate → checkoutAddressAssociate → shippingQuotes → checkoutSelectShippingQuote → checkoutAddCoupon → paymentMethods → checkoutSelectPaymentMethod → checkoutComplete.

commands.name: wake-code-review
commands.description: Code quality review for Wake Commerce storefront. Style, patterns, maintainability, TypeScript hygiene, and alignment with Wake skills. Delegates detailed review to the wake-code-reviewer agent.

commands.name: wake-migrate-storefront-query
commands.description: Port Wake Storefront reference Queries/*.graphql to headless. Extract root field, args, fragment; generate equivalent headless query; map to target framework.

commands.name: wake-performance-review
commands.description: Performance review for Wake Commerce storefront. Covers GraphQL query shape, caching, images, and Core Web Vitals. Delegates Lighthouse capture to the web-performance-audit skill and detailed analysis to the wake-performance-engineer agent.

commands.name: wake-product-page
commands.description: Build a Wake Commerce product detail page. Load product by productId, resolve variant via attributeSelections, render prices/images/add-to-cart. Handles addToCartFromSpot, customizations, subscriptions.

commands.name: wake-query-review
commands.description: GraphQL query design review for Wake Commerce storefronts. Schema alignment, fragments, batching, and field-selection hygiene. Delegates detailed redesign to the wake-graphql-architect agent.

commands.name: wake-search-page
commands.description: Build a Wake Commerce search page. Call search(query, partnerAccessToken), use productsByOffset for pagination, apply filters and aggregations.

commands.name: wake-security-audit
commands.description: Security audit for Wake Commerce storefront. Review token handling, auth, data exposure, OWASP alignment. Delegates detailed analysis to the wake-security-auditor agent.

commands.name: wake-test-plan
commands.description: Generate a test plan for a Wake Commerce storefront feature. Defines E2E scenarios, contract tests, and acceptance criteria. Delegates detailed test design to the wake-qa-expert agent.

commands.name: publish-copy
commands.description: Internal maintainer command. Copy only spec-derived plugin artifacts to the publish repository. Reads tooling/rules/publish-copy.mdc for inclusion/exclusion. Destination from .env.local (PUBLISH_REPO_PATH), .publish-config.json, or env (config overrides env). Lives under tooling/ and is NEVER published to the marketplace.
headings: Parse .env.local without executing it: only KEY=VALUE lines, ignore comments
